integrity: Prior hypergeometric mean identity is credited to Nipperess and Matsen; the claimed boundary rests on complete binary-shape enumeration through six and explicit positive ultrametric examples and grafting for arbitrary larger n.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete species-based rooted-PD mean curves, unordered strictly binary topologies, positive edge lengths; not partial curves, labeled reconstruction, unrooted PD, variable abundance, or tree networks. Explicit seven-tip witness and all-size induction, but no independent validation.
title: Seven taxa are the sharp first failure of topology recovery from complete mean phylogenetic-diversity rarefaction
